anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show zero activity in active trades, total P&L, win rate, and ROI, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load average and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configuration and logs to identify why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
Evaluate the active trading strategies to ensure they are properly configured and aligned with current market conditions.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to ensure it is operational and correctly configured.
